bio.text: Ed Setzler has served in the Georgia Senate since 2023, representing Senate District 37 in Cobb and Bartow counties, after 18 years in the Georgia House of Representatives.
Setzler earned a BS in Physics from Furman University in 1992 and served nine years on active duty as a U.S. Army officer.
Setzler chairs the Senate Committee on Science & Technology.
